head: 610b4ec3
runtime_state: localhost capture used HEAD 610b4ec3 plus uncommitted local login-control changes in the working tree; code changes were not authored or committed by QA3.

reference_policy.visual_reference: Cosmo legacy/shadcn reference supplied by PO via source-thread attachments and prior local smoke artifact
reference_policy.reference_handling: Reference screenshots that include browser chrome are used as source labels only and are not copied into this artifact set.
reference_policy.expected_visual_direction: shadcn/Cosmo visual, not old Umami visual: centered login card, Cosmo sidebar/shell, shadcn tokens for cards, tables, forms and buttons.

capture_policy.method: Playwright screenshots of local app viewport
capture_policy.sanitization: No full URLs, raw route IDs, cookies, tokens, credentials or payload rows recorded in text artifacts.
capture_policy.mutation: No implementation, deploy, restart, DB change, Umami production mutation or data mutation. Local login created only an ephemeral browser session for visual capture.

screenshots.coverage: Login card, language selector and theme control
Authenticated websites list with Cosmo shell, sidebar, search, table and Add website button
Mobile websites list, top shell and cardified rows
Authenticated website overview with Cosmo sidebar, metrics, chart, cards, map and heatmap

component_family_inventory.expected: Cosmo/shadcn centered login card with Cosmolytics brand, quiet copy, card radius/shadow/border, primary button tokens and clean language/theme controls.
component_family_inventory.actual: Centered shadcn-like card exists and now shows Cosmolytics branding. Copy still reads as legacy Umami/admin tone, and language/theme controls sit below card instead of forming a polished Cosmo auth footer.

component_family_inventory.expected: Cosmo workspace shell with branded sidebar, selected item state, section grouping and bottom user control.
component_family_inventory.actual: Desktop websites and overview show Cosmo shell/sidebar with shadcn selected states and grouped navigation. Mobile shows a compact top bar and content shell.

component_family_inventory.expected: shadcn page heading, divider, compact primary actions and consistent action placement.
component_family_inventory.actual: Websites page uses clean heading, divider and primary Add website button. Overview uses compact header/edit action and filter/date controls, but remains closer to Umami overview layout than Cosmo legacy dashboard composition.

component_family_inventory.expected: Cards with shadcn border/radius/background, consistent spacing, no nested-card heaviness, and quiet operational density.
component_family_inventory.actual: Websites list uses a large shadcn card; overview cards and chart panels use shadcn-like borders. Mobile websites rows become separate framed cards and feel heavier than desktop table.

component_family_inventory.expected: shadcn table/list rows with clear row actions, aligned columns, restrained dividers and responsive transformation.
component_family_inventory.actual: Desktop websites table is close: search, columns, row action icons. Mobile transforms rows into cards, but action icon sits on its own row and vertical spacing feels awkward.

component_family_inventory.expected: Inputs, search, language selector, theme control, filter button and date dropdown use consistent shadcn tokens, icon sizing and focus treatment.
component_family_inventory.actual: Search/add/filter/date controls are mostly shadcn. Login form has shadcn input/button base and Cosmolytics logo, but non-Cosmo copy and separated footer controls.

component_family_inventory.expected: Tabs and empty states should match shadcn/Cosmo tokens, with calm copy and balanced vertical space.
component_family_inventory.actual: Overview tabs render with shadcn underline styling and empty states are present. Empty states are plain and visually sparse across large panels.

component_family_inventory.expected: Metric cards, chart, map and heatmap should use Cosmo/shadcn styling while preserving readable analytics density.
component_family_inventory.actual: Overview includes cards, chart, map and heatmap. It still visually resembles Umami analytics panels more than Cosmo legacy widget/dashboard language, but tokens are closer to shadcn than old Umami.

component_family_inventory.expected: Mobile should preserve Cosmo brand, command hierarchy and comfortable shadcn spacing without awkward row stacking.
component_family_inventory.actual: Login mobile is centered and stable. Websites mobile preserves brand/top bar and CTA, but table-to-card transformation needs row/action alignment polish.

blockers.note: Authenticated local visual capture succeeded after ephemeral local session.
